subtitle: Crash-Proof Arithmetic for Autonomous Systems
executive_hook: Singular arithmetic crashes cost industry billions—from Ariane 5 guidance failures to smart contract drain attacks and autonomous vehicle sensor disengagements caused by division-by-zero panics. Classical software relies on defensive null-checks, fragile exception cascades, and IEEE 754 NaN contamination that silently poisons downstream control loops.
formal_breakthrough: WheelCore eliminates arithmetic singularities by formalizing Carlström Wheel Theory (W(Q)) via totalized algebra. Division is totalized (1/0 = ∞, 0/0 = ⊥) alongside an involutive reciprocal (//x = x) and regularized distributivity ((x+y)z + 0z = xz + yz). Singularities become first-class algebraic values with sound propagation, preventing division panics without sacrificing equational reasoning. Validated via 8 Carlström wheel properties on a 7-element representative domain (0, 1, -1, 2/3, -5/7, ∞, ⊥) spanning 1,190 sample checks.
